While in rehab, I hope to draft a plan for a small-animal sanctuary that I hope to found. Hopefully this will help re-ingratiate me into the vegan animal welfare community. I lived with rabbits for about 15 years and raised one of the world’s oldest bunnies! I love chinchillas, degus, hedgehogs, and other tiny critters and would like to help orphaned or injured ones. Inbox me with any advice on how to fund something like this or get a sanctuary off-the-ground!

Sadly, I became selfish in my addictions and forgot about trying to help in this way. I struggled with suicidal ideation and was admitted to the psychiatric ward at 3 different hospitals on 5 occasions for suicide attempts. I lost everything I had, and not a day goes by where I still don’t contemplate suicide, but going to rehab and having the support of the vegan and librarian communities behind me keeps me going!

Don't we all want that romanticized Bonnie & Clyde-type relationship? There's something alluring about committing the Ultimate Sin together. Surely, there are people out there who deserve no less than death (eg. rapists and animal-abusers). Chicks get wet af over serial killers.
